subject: Intro + scheduling: Redwood demo and IT/security intake for Globex
messages:
From: noreply@redwood.ai
To: maria.gomez@globex.com
Date: Thu, 14 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Thanks for signing up — next steps (Redwood demo)

Hi Maria,

Thanks for signing up for a Redwood demo — we received your request. An SDR will reach out to coordinate a short walkthrough tailored to your use case. If you have immediate constraints (IT/security, preferred dates, or timezone notes), reply to this email and we’ll prioritize them.

Best,
Redwood Onboarding Team

---
Automated message: do not reply directly to this address.
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@globex.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Aug 2025 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Thanks for signing up — Redwood demo and intake

Hi Maria — great to meet you (virtually). I’m Soojin on the SDR team — thanks for signing up. I’d love to get a 30-minute slot on the calendar this week to run through: your primary goals, data constraints, and a quick live demo.

Proposed times (all shown in your local timezone, I believe PDT):
- Fri 8/15 10:00–10:30 PDT (17:00–17:30 UTC)
- Mon 8/18 09:00–09:30 PDT (16:00–16:30 UTC)

If neither works, paste a few windows that do. Also copying Ben (AE) and Priyom (SE) so they can join for the technical bit. If you have an IT/security contact, please add them or let me know and we’ll include the security checklist in advance.

Quick notes attached: the Redwood demo deck (light) and our security checklist — these are just to speed the conversation.

Calendly link (all timezones): https://calendly.com/redwood/30min-demo?slot=AU-EMEA-US

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
SDR, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0134
From: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@globex.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Diego Alvarez <diego.alvarez@globex.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Aug 2025 16:35:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Re: Thanks for signing up — Redwood demo and intake

Hi Soojin — thanks for the quick follow up. Either of those windows could work but we need to include our security lead. Diego (copied) is our IT security manager and he’s only available in the late afternoon CET. Could you and your team do Fri 8/15 at 17:00 UTC (which I think is your 10:00 PDT) or Fri 8/15 at 18:00 UTC (11:00 PDT)? If Ben or Priyom can do a slightly later slot that would help us.

Also, Diego asked if you can confirm whether we need to execute an NDA ahead of the demo and whether there are any files we should review before the call (we’re focused on data residency and audit logs).

Thanks,
Maria
Director of Product Management, Globex
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@globex.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Aug 2025 12:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Re: Re: Thanks for signing up — Redwood demo and intake

Hi Maria, Diego — Ben here (AE). 17:00 UTC on Fri 8/15 works for me. Priyom — can you confirm you can join for the technical portion and cover data residency/audit log questions?

On the NDA: we generally do not require an NDA for an initial demo — most customers prefer a short mutual NDA if product details or sensitive architecture discussion is expected. If you’d like, I can start a mutual NDA DocuSign and share a link before the call.

Attached: redwood-security-checklist-v1.pdf (short checklist we share with IT teams) and a lightweight demo deck. The checklist answers most common data residency and logging questions; Priyom, please add anything we should flag for Globex specifically.

Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0189

---
Attachments: redwood-security-checklist-v1.pdf (8KB stub), redwood-demo-deck-2025-08.pdf (120KB stub)
From: Diego Alvarez <security@globex.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@globex.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Aug 2025 08:03:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Re: Re: Re: Thanks for signing up — Redwood demo and intake

Thanks — I can do Fri 15 Aug 17:00 UTC. Please send the calendar invite in UTC and include the checklist link. I reviewed the attached checklist and had two quick asks we can cover in the call:
- Confirm whether KV cache or prefix caching is logged in audit trails for customer-managed deployments.
- Clarify the retention window for request/trace logs in the hosted product and whether logs are masked when using private deployments with customer-managed KMS.

We don’t need an NDA for the demo; a mutual NDA beforehand would be OK if you plan to share architecture diagrams beyond the public docs.

I’ve accepted the proposed slot on my calendar. Looking forward.

Diego Alvarez
IT Security Manager, Globex
security@globex.com | +44 20 7946 0958
